intro: Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents for small businesses. Where a platform offers an API, Prestique connects the agent to it so calls turn into real records in your system. Zenoti provides an API to retrieve available slots for a service booking, and endpoints to mark an appointment as confirmed or undo confirmation. The agent uses those to do its work inside the system you already use.

You keep the software you already use; the agent works with it rather than replacing it. The agent only does what Zenoti's API allows and what you have approved it to do. Booking follows your own rules, such as your hours, your capacity and what the agent won't do. You control what the agent says and does, and changes are made when you ask for them.
